evaluation.overallAssessment: The Belfort persona moved through the BCSM stages faster than any other persona — but that speed created a trust deficit that showed up in the close. The procedural-vs-political reframe in Stage 3 was the session's strongest individual move. The core weakness: Stage 2 empathy was almost entirely skipped, leaving Bato's commitment contingent on external verification (his lawyer) rather than personal trust in the negotiator.
keyImprovementAreas: Stage 1: spend one full exchange listening before introducing urgency
Stage 2: after Bato discloses a fear, reflect it back before solving it — do not skip straight to the solution
Stage 5: the conditional close is a symptom of insufficient empathy in Stage 2 — fix the root, not the branch
